passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

primaryAbilities.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
primaryAbilities.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowamountpercent }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds {{ refundratio*100 }}% of it's Mana cost.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Cozy Campfire
primaryAbilities.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Ally champions nearby gain {{ rangepercent }} Attack Range and restore {{ healingovertime }} Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every {{ healfrequencyseconds }} seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Warm Hugs
primaryAbilities.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting {{ shieldcalc }} Shield and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Breath of Life
primaryAbilities.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, restoring <healing>{{ healcalc }} Health</healing>, and granting {{ tenacityamount*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ tenacityduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
